story_generator.name: Story Generator
story_generator.notes: Music Studio: Analyze Song uses a Python rhyme analysis as its rhyme evidence and refuses malformed or copied AI output (the page lists why); Basic caption builder; app-wide font size; Ctrl+click several AI Recommend style cards and queue one song per card with its own BPM, key and time signature. 0.3.1 fix: the packaged Music Studio bundles pythainlp and numpy.
